reported.title: Heartbeat starved during siren pulse
reported.description: runSirenBurst() blocks in delay(SIREN_MS) at line 38 for the full 2000 ms, so loop() cannot reach the heartbeat check at lines 60-65. Measured gaps of 2000 ms and 2249 ms between 'hb' lines confirm the serial output stops for the whole pulse. Expected /^hb$/ every 250 ± 100 ms; 5 of 4 intervals were out of tolerance, worst gap 2000 ms.

reported.title: Firmware silent for 2000 ms during siren
reported.description: The blocking delay(SIREN_MS) at line 38 halts all serial and pin activity for 2000 ms, exceeding the 700 ms limit. Measured 'no activity for 2000 ms' gaps across all scenarios confirm this. Firmware went silent for 2000 ms with no serial output or pin activity (limit 700 ms); 5 such gap(s).

judge_input.spec:
- Kiln door switch on D2 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); siren driver on D8.
- A settled door-open press as short as 40 ms starts a 2000 ms HIGH pulse on D8 within 150 ms.
- While a siren pulse is already running, additional presses are ignored (do not restart the pulse).
- Print the exact line `hb` every 250 ms at all times, including during the siren pulse.
- Firmware must never go silent (no serial and no pin change) for more than 700 ms.
- Idle door contact reads HIGH.
